hero_policy: Use one dominant hero by default, with a complementary sub-hero only when it advances the section story. Every source photo must be rendered exactly once; similarity lowers prominence but never removes an asset.

composition_policy.similarity_rule: Keep near-duplicates in a visible sequence or contact area; allow at most one prominent member per similarity group.
composition_policy.visual_weight_policy: Use one dominant hero (1.0), a complementary sub-hero only when it advances the story (0.55), supporting views at about 0.3, and detail/contact views at 0.12-0.22. Lower visual weight changes scale and rhythm, never inclusion.
composition_policy.variation_policy: Choose controlled composition_variant values from orientation, subject matter, sequence and album position. Do not randomize, and do not repeat the same dominant geometry on adjacent pages when a nearby variant is available.
composition_policy.album_rhythm_policy: Consider previous and next pages: alternate open/quiet hero pages with denser sequence or detail pages, and avoid repeating the same hero side or contact rhythm across adjacent pages.
